title: Transport of negative rank-one tensor factors to the positive internal dual
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring and d an adic coefficient datum. Let O, F, completedCechCoefficientUnit and b_i be the coefficient/site transport and residue sections of [def-weil-pbc-completed-cech-site-transport], and G the completed constant extension of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. The complexwise realization of B_m(a) of [def-weil-pbc-finite-negative-koszul-tensor] along G followed by F is isomorphic to the strict dual tower Q_m(O,b) of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. The isomorphisms commute with the consecutive recursive tensor transitions. The map given by completedCechCoefficientUnit followed by F(completedKoszulOne), followed by (G followed by F) applied to the recursive algebraic tensor unit, maps to the degree-zero dual augmentation. Only one-generator exterior factors occur in this assertion, and no arbitrary exterior-to-tensor identification is assumed.

proof.text: Apply negativeKoszulTensorRealization to identify the algebraic negative tensor after coefficient/site transport with the explicit negative two-term tensor, including its consecutive transition and empty-subset unit equations.

For a nonempty list apply ringedNegativeKoszulSuccDuality on the completed Cech site. For the empty list use the proved ringedNegativeKoszulZeroDuality, which is inverse Hom-unit evaluation and identifies the two identity transitions and empty basis unit. Compose this chain isomorphism with the coefficient realization at each m. Reassociate, use the realization transition equality and then the internal duality transition equality. For the degree-zero unit, the component of a composite chain map is the composite of components; reassociate and substitute the two unit equations. This proves both required equations without modifying the target statement.

lean.statement:
theorem negativeKoszulTensorDualTransport
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) :
    let F := intrinsicPresentationModulesBack X d ⋙ (completedCechModulesEquiv X d).functor
    let G := completedKoszulConstant X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d)
    let H := (G ⋙ F).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let O := completedCechRing X d
    let b := fun i ↦ completedCechScalar X d (a i)
    ∃ e : ∀ m : ℕ, H.obj (finiteNegativeKoszulTensor r a m) ≅
        (ringedKoszulDualTower O r b).obj (op m),
      (∀ m, H.map (finiteNegativeKoszulTransition r a m) ≫ (e m).hom =
        (e (m + 1)).hom ≫ (ringedKoszulDualTower O r b).map
          (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ m)).op) ∧
      (∀ m, completedCechCoefficientUnit X d ≫ F.map (completedKoszulOne X
          (intrinsicPresentationDatum d)) ≫ (G ⋙ F).map
            (finiteNegativeKoszulUnitZero r a m) ≫ (e m).hom.f 0 =
        (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (.up ℤ) 0 _).inv ≫
          (ringedKoszulDualUnit O r b m).f 0)
